paraOficinas.transparenciaTexto: Today, registering and using the management system is free, and we don't charge founding partners any commission. If that changes in the future, you'll be notified at least 30 days before any charge takes effect, in line with our

faq.pergunta: How much does the BipFix management system cost my shop?
faq.resposta: Registering and using the management tools (schedule, quotes, staff, reviews) has no monthly fee. Today, we don't charge founding partners any commission. If that changes in the future, we'll give at least 30 days' notice before any charge, per our Terms of Use.

faq.pergunta: How does BipFix help my shop get more customers?
faq.resposta: Drivers in your area who need repairs send photos of the damage and get quotes from nearby shops, including yours. Your public profile also shows up on Google for anyone searching for shops in your city, with your reviews, specialties and location.

faq.pergunta: Does the system replace a spreadsheet or a scheduling notebook?
faq.resposta: Yes. You organize your schedule by vehicle and by staff member, distribute work among mechanics, control your service capacity and get automatic notifications — all in one place, with no paper or loose spreadsheets.

faq.pergunta: Do I need technical knowledge to use it?
faq.resposta: No. The platform was designed for the everyday reality of a repair shop, with a guided learning portal built right into the system so you and your team can learn each feature in minutes.

faq.pergunta: Can I buy parts from suppliers through the platform?
faq.resposta: Yes. You can open parts quote requests to partner suppliers and other shops in your area, compare prices and lead times, and negotiate directly over chat before confirming the order.

paraOficinas.ctaFinalTitulo: Ready to organize your shop and win more customers?

home.porQueBadge: AN AMBITIOUS PROJECT, EARLY IN THE JOURNEY
home.porQueTexto1: Today, choosing where to get your car fixed usually comes down to a referral or whichever shop is closest — with no way to compare price, timeline or track record. We believe drivers deserve transparency, and that good repair shops deserve to be found for the work they deliver.
home.porQueTexto2: We're, literally, just getting started: selecting the first partner shops and parts suppliers to launch with full attention in one city at a time, instead of growing fast with no quality control.
home.parceiroTitulo: There's still time to join as a founding partner
home.parceiroTexto: If you're a driver, you can already use the platform today. If you run a repair shop or parts business, we're selecting a limited number of partners for the pilot phase — with no commission right now.
home.faqSubtitulo: Get your questions about the BipFix platform answered

faqItems.resposta: You send photos of the damage to your vehicle along with a description of the problem. Nearby repair shops receive your request, assess the job and send detailed quotes. You compare prices, timelines and reviews, and choose the best option.

faqItems.pergunta: Is it safe to use the platform?
faqItems.resposta: Yes! Every registered shop goes through verification. On top of that, the review system lets you see each shop's reputation before deciding. Your personal data is protected and never shared without your consent.

For drivers, the platform is completely free. You can send requests, receive quotes and compare options at no cost. We're in the founding-partner selection phase, and today we charge no commission or monthly fee to partner shops and suppliers — see the details in our Terms of Use.
After each completed job, the customer can rate the shop from 1 to 5 stars and leave a comment. The average rating is shown on the shop's public profile, helping other drivers choose with confidence.

faqItems.pergunta: Can I use BipFix in an emergency?
faqItems.resposta: Yes! We have an "I've just crashed" emergency button that lets you log the incident quickly, take photos on the spot and get quotes from nearby shops within minutes. You can also log the other vehicle involved.

faqItems.pergunta: What kinds of services do the shops offer?
faqItems.resposta: Shops on the platform offer a wide range of services such as bodywork, paint, general mechanics, auto electrics, glass replacement, wheel alignment, balancing, air conditioning and much more. Each shop lists its specialties on its profile.
